set.body:
Context: scalafim.pipeline is an in-memory DAG evaluator with Any-backed artifact storage and runner semantics. Eidolon now owns the durable typed workflow kernel and persisted FlowDocument. Maintaining two workflow authorities would create divergent identity, validation, planning, caching, and provenance semantics.

Scope:
- Freeze scalafim.pipeline against new product-workflow features; allow only defect fixes needed during migration.
- Inventory and port reusable graph tests (cycle detection, stable ordering, failure propagation, cancellation, and receipt behavior) to eidolon's workflow kernel or conformance suite.
- Preserve only lower-level graph utilities that have independent scientific/library value; they must not expose workflow, scheduler, cache, publication, or run-lifecycle authority.
- Deprecate and then remove PipelineStep, PipelineGraph, ExecutionPlan, PipelineRun, PipelineProvenance, and Any-backed ArtifactTable after consumers migrate.

Acceptance:
- A migration matrix maps each public pipeline API and test to retain, replace, or remove.
- New orchestration features are rejected from scalafim.pipeline.
- Eidolon can consume scalafim scientific modules through explicit adapters without depending on scalafim.pipeline.
- Removal criteria and compatibility window are documented.

Downstream consumer: eidolon workflow-kernel and boundary-conformance milestones; tracking issue bd-01KXYH4NRMFGV41W48AD6N5Y0P.
set.title: RFE: freeze and retire scalafim-pipeline workflow authority
